steps.t: Refresh creative before the audience tires.
steps.d: New hooks, formats and creators enter on a fixed cycle, and tired ads are retired rather than pushed harder.

steps.t: Choose creators by fit on a real body.
steps.d: Style, size range and audience fit decide the shortlist, not follower count. Terms are written down first.

steps.t: Feed the whole range to dynamic ads.
steps.d: Catalogues and feeds are structured so ads show the right item, not only a handful of hero pieces.

steps.t: Fix size help where wrong-size orders start.
steps.d: Size guides, fit notes and honest imagery on the product page cut the orders that come back.

steps.t: Report margin after returns and discounts.
steps.d: Spend is judged on what is left once returns, discounts and shipping are counted, not on gross ROAS.
